tier_history.reason: DEMOTED out of PRIMARY on Wave S2b's finding that this file's two 'measured' values are a REPO-INTERNAL DERIVATION, not a measurement from 10.1021/jf9705983 or from any other paper (see measured_volatiles[*].content_correction_note and content_verification_note.wave_s2c_retirement below). A PRIMARY benchmark is a quantitative literature anchor; this is not one. 'REFERENCE' is the tier used for a benchmark that stays in the tree and is still EXECUTED -- it exercises the free-precursor sulfur network end to end and is a useful mechanistic diagnostic -- but whose comparator values carry no evidential weight. MECHANICAL EFFECT: src/validation_contract.py's ValidationContract.strict_gate_tiers is ('PRIMARY',), so is_strict_gate_eligible() now returns False for this file and it can no longer contribute a strict-ready pass. WHAT THIS TIER DOES NOT DO, stated so nobody reads more into it than it carries: the file still declares `measured_volatiles`, so its rows are still ENUMERATED and still SCORED in benchmark_summary / validation_overview / prediction_uncertainty, where they appear as large misses against a fabricated yardstick. That is deliberate for now -- hiding the row is not the same as marking it -- but it means the fold errors printed for this benchmark anywhere are errors against the repo's own guess and must never be quoted as accuracy against literature. Taking it fully out of the scored population needs one of two further OWNER decisions: move the block to `reference_volatiles` (the treatment thiamine_cys_xylose_145C_Cerny2008 already carries for its own unverified value), or quarantine the file to data/benchmarks/quarantined/. Wave S2c took neither, because both change panel membership and the staged plan is to REBUILD this benchmark from the ILL retrieval in native mol %.

metadata.notes: RETIRED AS A QUANTITATIVE ANCHOR 2026-08-27 (Wave S2c). Previously: 'Quantitative free amino-acid sulfur benchmark used for strict-ready calibration.' That description was false in both halves -- the values are not quantitative literature and the calibration built on them was circular. The file is kept as a MECHANISTIC REFERENCE: it is the only free-precursor cysteine/ribose system in the tree, it exercises the whole sulfur network (thiohemiacetal -> FFT and pentodiulose -> MFT) plus the pH-5 enolisation branch point, and the conditions block (140 C / 30 min / equimolar) is a faithful copy of Mottram & Nobrega 2002's genuine protocol even though the concentrations attached to it are not theirs. THE SULFUR BRANCH NOW HAS ZERO ABSOLUTE LITERATURE ANCHORS.

content_verification_note.note: The paper's abstract reports MFT/FFT yields in mol % (e.g. MFT 1.4 mol % for its best precursor system), not ppb. The 342/200 ppb values here require a mol%->ppb conversion (system volume, precursor moles, molecular weights) that is NOT documented anywhere in this repo, and the full text is paywalled so the values could not be confirmed against the paper's tables. This is the panel's tightest contract (1.45x / 0.09 dex) resting on an unverified derivation. Needs: full-text access to 10.1021/jf9705983 and a written conversion, or replacement with the paper's native mol % as the target unit.

wave_s2_followup.retrieval_outcome: STILL CLOSED. Every route exhausted: ACS returns 403, Unpaywall reports oa_locations [], OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar both CLOSED, five open-access citing papers pulled in full text reproduce no yield, Google Books zero volumes, and Cerny 2015 cites the paper five times without quoting a number. Only the abstract is obtainable, and its mol % figures (1.4 / 0.05) belong to a DRY 180 C intermediate system, not to this aqueous benchmark.
wave_s2_followup.conditions_attribution_question: The conditions recorded here — 140 C / 30 min / EQUIMOLAR cysteine:ribose — appear to be MISATTRIBUTED. Cerny (2015) states verbatim that Hofmann & Schieberle's aqueous ribose/cysteine model was 145 C / 20 min at 1:3 cysteine:ribose. The 140 C / 30 min / equimolar protocol is that of Mottram & Nobrega 2002 (10.1021/jf0200826) — but Mottram & Nobrega reported headspace GC-MS, not solution ppb, so they are not the source of 342 / 200 either. Neither paper has been shown to be the origin of these numbers.
wave_s2_followup.implied_mol_percent: On the UNVERIFIED 10 mM basis this file declares, and with MFT/FFT MW 114.17, the recorded ppb imply MFT 0.0300 mol % and FFT 0.0175 mol % (342e-6 / 114.17 / 0.010 x 100). Forward, the abstract's 1.4 mol % would be 15984 ppb (46.7x this target) and its 0.05 mol % would be 571 ppb (2.85x). NOT CONFIRMED AND NOT REFUTED — chemically plausible, traceable to nothing. The 10 mM basis is itself unverified, so the conversion carries a free multiplicative parameter underneath the panel's tightest contract.
wave_s2_followup.not_changed: No measured value, no DOI, no condition and no contract threshold was edited. This note records an open attribution question for the owner; resolving it needs institutional/ILL access to the body of 10.1021/jf9705983, or a decision to re-express the target in the paper's native mol %.

wave_s2_followup.wave_s2b_correction_1_the_origin_is_repo: The attribution question recorded above is SETTLED and the answer is neither paper. 342 / 200 ppb were derived INSIDE THIS REPOSITORY, from data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 1.3 — an abstract-reconstructed range table committed in c7efbbc, the SAME commit that created this file. Line 88 of that document tabulates, for 'Ribose + Cys, pH 5 aqueous | 140 | 30 min', MFT ~0.02-0.05 mol % and FFT ~0.01-0.03 mol %. On this file's declared 10 mM basis with MW 114.17: MFT 0.0300 mol % -> 342.5 ppb, FFT 0.0175 mol % -> 199.8 ppb. Both shipped values are interior points of two INVENTED bands (Wave S2b confidence ~90%). CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS FILE'S OWN CONTRACT: the source band is 0.02-0.05 mol % = 228-571 ppb, a 2.5x spread, so the 1.45x / 0.09 dex validation_contract below is ~1.7x TIGHTER THAN ITS OWN SOURCE. SECOND CONSEQUENCE: the MFT 342 > FFT 200 ordering is an artifact of where inside the two OVERLAPPING bands (MFT 228-571, FFT 114-342) the midpoints were picked — it is not a measured ordering, so any claim resting on 'the model disagrees with Hofmann at pH 5' rests on a non-measurement. Wave S1b's prose has been corrected accordingly.
wave_s2_followup.wave_s2b_correction_2_off_by_one_paper: The sentence above attributing '145 C / 20 min at 1:3' to Hofmann & Schieberle via Cerny 2015 is OFF BY ONE PAPER. Cerny's sentence cites Hofmann & Schieberle 1995 (10.1021/jf00056a042, JAFC 43:2187-2194); his reference list disambiguates 1998a (the Z. Lebensm. dry-roasting paper) from 1998b (10.1021/jf9705983, this file's DOI). Cerny states NOTHING about this paper's conditions. That 10.1021/jf9705983 reused the 145 C / 20 min aqueous protocol is an INFERENCE (~85%), resting on one secondary sentence from BBB 2016 (10.1080/09168451.2016.1238295) whose full text could not be served.

What is false is only the pair of concentrations.

RETIRED.was: The tightest scale contract in the whole panel, and the one the repo repeatedly described as its most demanding.
RETIRED.reason: THE CONTRACT WAS TIGHTER THAN ITS OWN SOURCE'S STATED SPREAD, BY A FACTOR OF ~1.7. The MFT target 342 ppb is 0.0300 mol %, taken from inside data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 1.3's band `~0.02-0.05` mol %. Propagated honestly on this file's own 10 mM / MW 114.17 basis that band is 228-571 ppb -- a 2.5x spread. A 1.45x max_ratio contract cannot be earned from a 2.5x band; a tolerance narrower than its source's uncertainty is a fitting tell, which is the same pattern data/benchmarks/quarantined/README.md records for the files quarantined on 2026-08-26. The FFT band, `~0.01-0.03` mol % = 114-342 ppb, OVERLAPS the MFT band, so even the MFT > FFT ORDERING this file encodes is an artifact of which interior points were picked, not a measured ordering.
RETIRED.not_replaced_by_a_looser_one: No replacement threshold was installed, and the honest reason is that there is nothing to set one from. A contract has to come from a measurement's reported precision; there is no measurement. Widening 1.45x to (say) 2.5x so the file would pass would be inventing a tolerance around an invented value -- the exact move this audit exists to stop.
RETIRED.WHAT_APPLIES_INSTEAD_read_this_before_ca: Removing `scale_thresholds` does NOT leave this benchmark untested: src/benchmark_validation.py::_resolve_scale_thresholds falls back to the GLOBAL free-precursor defaults in src/validation_contract.py::BenchmarkThresholds, i.e. max_ratio 1.5 and mean_abs_log10_error 0.10. Those defaults are marginally LOOSER than the retired 1.45 / 0.09, and that difference is stated here rather than left for a reader to discover, because a silent relaxation is exactly what this wave is cleaning up. It buys nothing: with `thiol_addition_pentodiulose` reverted to 28.60 the benchmark scores max_ratio 4.3797 and MALE 0.4041 dex, so it fails the inherited default by ~2.9x on ratio and ~4x on log error -- a far wider failure than the 2.2086 / 0.2352 it was failing the retired contract by. The row got WORSE and nothing about that is hidden. What the retirement removes is the CLAIM that 1.45x was an earned, literature-derived tolerance.
RETIRED.consequence: This file can no longer contribute a strict-ready pass (it also lost strict-gate eligibility via metadata.tier PRIMARY -> REFERENCE). Strict-ready was 0/14 before this wave and is 0/14 after it -- this benchmark was FAILING its contract at 2.2086x / 0.2352 dex immediately before this wave (and at 4.3797x / 0.4041 dex after this wave's `thiol_addition_pentodiulose` 26.35 -> 28.60 revert), so retiring the contract removes a FAILURE, not a pass, and the strict-ready aggregate does not move.

2-methyl-3-furanthiol.content_correction_note: 2026-08-27 (Wave S2c, executing Wave S2b): THIS IS NOT A MEASUREMENT. It is a REPO-INTERNAL DERIVATION, ~90% confidence, arithmetic exact. Origin: data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 1.3, an abstract-reconstructed range table committed in c7efbbc -- the SAME commit that created this JSON file. That table's row reads verbatim: `| Ribose + Cys, pH 5 aqueous | 140 | 30 min | ~0.02-0.05 | ~0.01-0.03 |` (MFT mol %, FFT mol %). Picking 0.0300 mol % from inside the MFT band and converting on this file's declared 10 mM basis with MW 114.17 (MFT and FFT are both C5H6OS, so one MW serves both): 3.0e-4 x 0.010 M x 114.17 g/mol = 3.4251e-4 g/L = 342.5 ug/L -> 342 ppb. Nothing in Hofmann & Schieberle 1998 (10.1021/jf9705983), nothing in Mottram & Nobrega 2002 (10.1021/jf0200826), and nothing in any retrievable literature produces 342. The section-1.3 table is itself abstract-derived guesswork -- its only bold unhedged row (1.4 / 0.05 mol %) is verbatim from the 1998 abstract's DRY 180 C / 6 min intermediate system, its `Furfural + H2S ~0.5` cell is 10 x 0.05 arithmetic on the abstract's 'a 10 times higher efficiency' sentence, its `Glucose + Cys` cell reads `~10x lower than ribose` (prose in a numeric column), and its 140 C / 30 min conditions are transplanted from section 1.1, which is Mottram & Nobrega. THE 10 mM BASIS IS ITSELF UNATTESTED, so this ppb figure also carries a free multiplicative parameter: halve the assumed concentration and the target halves while the chemistry is unchanged. DO NOT fit against this value, do not cite it, and do not report agreement or disagreement with it as accuracy against literature. Full trail: tasks/audit_remediation.md '## Wave S2b' and '## Wave S2c'.
2-methyl-3-furanthiol.value_left_unchanged_deliberately: 342 is NOT edited to a band midpoint, a mol % or anything else. Changing the number would destroy the evidence that this specific number was shipped as a literature measurement for four months. The label, not the value, is what this wave corrects.

2-furfurylthiol.content_correction_note: 2026-08-27 (Wave S2c, executing Wave S2b): THIS IS NOT A MEASUREMENT. Same origin as the MFT row above -- data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 1.3, committed in c7efbbc alongside this file. This value is the GEOMETRIC MEAN of that table's invented FFT band `~0.01-0.03` mol %: sqrt(0.01 x 0.03) = 0.017321 mol %, which on the declared 10 mM / MW 114.17 basis is 1.7321e-4 x 0.010 x 114.17 = 1.9776e-4 g/L = 197.8 ppb -> rounded to 200. (The recorded 200 ppb corresponds to 0.01752 mol %, i.e. the same band interior to within the rounding.) The FFT band, 114-342 ppb on this basis, OVERLAPS the MFT band, 228-571 ppb; the MFT 342 > FFT 200 ordering this file encodes is therefore midpoint selection, not chemistry, and taking the FFT band's top with the MFT band's bottom reverses it. Any claim resting on 'the model disagrees with Hofmann about MFT vs FFT at pH 5' rests on a non-measurement. DO NOT fit against this value, do not cite it, and do not report agreement or disagreement with it as accuracy against literature.
2-furfurylthiol.value_left_unchanged_deliberately: Same reason as the MFT row: the shipped number is the evidence.
